text: Dark chocolate or milk chocolate: which has more calories?
Dark does: five ninety-eight per hundred grams, milk five thirty-five.
Yet it has less than half the sugar: twenty-four grams, against fifty-two.
More cacao means more cocoa butter: forty-three grams of fat, against thirty.
And fat has nine calories a gram, sugar only four.
Thirty grams each: about one eighty versus one sixty. Log the grams, not the shade.
